The EC4 adds no neutral dwell of its own on a reversal (consistent with dI = 0.0 s, the factory default).
The actuator always returns the throttle to idle before it shifts. With the throttle above about 20 % that adds about 0.4 s.
With the engines running, propeller and RPM decay may still lag the mechanism. These figures are the mechanical minimum, not a safe reversal time under way.
